failed_attempts.reason: Initial audit attempted JSON parsing on an immutable README/code/double-gzip pin; no output directory or retained input changed.

An exact floating-point comparison rejected 4e-18 to 7e-18 square-degree rounding differences from the retained overlay. The final runner uses explicit rel_tol 1e-10 and abs_tol 1e-14 and retains both raw values.
Inventory closure check initially assumed a product path instead of following its immutable custody descriptor; corrected to bind the source inventory to the exact issue-pinned custody blob.

The output-admission control fixture initially targeted the wrong directory level and falsely reported one occupied-directory case as accepted. No real output was altered; corrected fixture passes all seven cases.

limits: Superseded runs and failed attempts remain historical; only the v14 pair is the final reproduction against the exact live issue contract.
The rejection control verifies source-lock pin identity; it does not establish boundary accuracy, source licensing, territorial meaning, or history.

recovered_attempts.note: A storage-gate check blocked run two at the first attempt; the gate later passed and the second fresh run completed. Both outputs are retained and paired.

audit_findings.finding: Independent review found a prior runner accepted a mutable source-lock substitution that changed actual_comparison_part-17 to the M vintage while the captured issue contract remained unchanged. That pair is superseded. The v14 runner now checks a hard-pinned exact issue-body hash and compares all 57 id/hash entries to the embedded reviewed work specification; the actual C-to-M mutation is a negative control rejected before output.
